scope: All active AWS IAM policy/role/user/group/credential report and account/configuration registry kinds at review snapshot
evidence_boundary: Source and grouped native contracts reviewed for every cohort callback. SDK Stubber validates SDK response shape only: IAM JSON grammar and CSV semantics require separate validation. Field rows account for every available field-producers accessor, not all possible dynamic data flow. Every ID deliberately has semantic_completeness_proven=false. No live AWS used.

upstream_boundary.catalog_sources: sources table contains exact existing pinned mapping revisions; older catalog source pins are not silently relabeled current. Metadata paths alone are lineage, not evaluator semantic proof.

current_cached_prowler.difference: check_admin_access treats missing Statement as empty; native malformed-data UNKNOWN validation intentionally corrects that. Privesc/NotAction algorithms remain finite/pinned source patterns, no Kingfisher equivalence claimed.

upstream_boundary.note: Existing core/parity source trees reused; no new HEAD refresh or source mapping mutation in this task.

reviewed_semantic_examples: iam_policy_all_attached_no_star_star (line1928): Allow literal * or *:* and Resource *, attached filter; AWS-managed bad row info versus native applicability distinction.
iam_user_unused_credentials_45 (line2125): root info; conditional nullable SQL dates; current_date threshold, not effective permission/credential correctness.
iam_policy_custom_no_blocked_kms_actions: exact lowercased kms:decrypt/kms:reencryptfrom equality, no implicit expansion of *; separate admin pattern supplies broader bounded signal.
iam_account_password_policy_one_uppercase_letter: account left join; typed native missing field remains UNKNOWN rather than SQL null alarm.
current_cached_steampipe_iam.limits: Native SDK producer contracts compared against selected cached SQL and source module helper comments; not all 376 lineage entries received independent upstream evaluator differential execution.

managed_gaad.consumer: default_document -> SQL std or Prowler document_of -> literal/cached-action-catalog policy matcher.
managed_gaad.field_contract: Arn, AttachmentCount, DefaultVersionId, PolicyVersionList[].{IsDefaultVersion,VersionId,Document}; JSON Statement contents are opaque SDK strings, not modeled IAM policy grammar.
managed_gaad.limits: GAAD population is not the all-unattached policy universe. Shared claude_aws_a_iam.default_document now binds default IDs; separate base/aws_a_iam_policies helpers still have the recorded contradiction gap. Policy patterns and finite-catalog NotAction handling are not SCP/boundary/session/condition effective-access evaluation.

inline_gaad.producer: aws._iam -> GAAD UserDetailList/RoleDetailList/GroupDetailList; URL-decode *PolicyList[].PolicyDocument; _provenance marks complete response.
inline_gaad.consumer: inline_policies -> std / Prowler document_of; matching principal-specific inline list.
inline_gaad.field_contract: UserPolicyList/RolePolicyList/GroupPolicyList PolicyName and PolicyDocument; API omission receipt can attest empty inline list, arbitrary absent native facts cannot.
inline_gaad.limits: Literal source algorithms differ among SQL/Prowler. Policy condition/deny/privesc patterns are bounded signals, not effective authorization. New independent SDK probes exercise admin pattern on all three native principal shapes.

principal_gaad.producer: aws._iam GAAD native details, AttachedManagedPolicies omission receipt, user ListAccessKeys/GetAccessKeyLastUsed/GetLoginProfile/ListMFADevices.
principal_gaad.consumer: attached_arns, group_members(user.GroupList), trust std/is_service_role, AccessKeys/LoginProfile/MFADevices typed wrappers.
principal_gaad.field_contract: Principal Arn/name/path, GroupList, AttachedManagedPolicies[].PolicyArn, AssumeRolePolicyDocument, RoleLastUsed, typed credential detail wrappers.
principal_gaad.limits: No federated session/Identity Center inventory, no SCP/boundary/session effective-access solving. Managed names identify exact attached policies only; not proof of all granted actions. SDK admin-inline probes also prove attachment omission projection, not every trust/MFA/attachment branch.

credential_csv.producer: aws._credentials_report -> GetCredentialReport(Content bytes, ReportFormat text/csv, GeneratedTime) -> csv.DictReader; ReportGeneratedTime retained.
credential_csv.consumer: csv_boolean / flag and callback-specific report_time/parse_time/now; two key slots only.
credential_csv.field_contract: CSV user/arn, password_enabled/mfa_active/access_key_N_active, ISO dates and documented N/A/no_information/not_supported sentinels.
credential_csv.limits: Read-only download never generates missing/expired reports. Parser validates CSV framing but not complete schema/enums, row identity uniqueness or report freshness; consumers vary in strictness. IAM/root credential metadata excludes federated sessions and service-specific credentials; last-used data has historical/aggregation limits.

password_scope.producer: aws._single(GetAccountPasswordPolicy); NoSuchEntity explicitly empty; global account wrapper.
password_scope.consumer: aws_a_iam.password_row -> complete_items -> unique PasswordPolicy; nine typed policy predicates.
password_scope.field_contract: MinimumPasswordLength, four Require* bools, PasswordReusePrevention, MaxPasswordAge. Omitted requested members UNKNOWN; proved absent policy FAIL.
password_scope.limits: IAM password policy does not evaluate root, federation, Identity Center or external IdP password strength. No new test claims all numeric domains; thresholds only.

account_presence.producer: aws._account_configuration GetAlternateContact(SECURITY) and DescribeOrganization; presence-only projection strips PII.
account_presence.limits: Registration is not current contact correctness or organization governance. GovCloud security contact is MANUAL; ownership/governance cannot be inferred from organization ID alone.

account_cloudtrail.producer: global cloudtrail_account_inventory across enabled regions, GetTrailStatus; explicit region selection intentionally incomplete.
account_cloudtrail.field_contract: aws_account.Account matched context account; complete inventory with SourceRegion/HomeRegion/TrailARN and Status.IsLogging.
account_cloudtrail.limits: At least one home-region logging trail only; not all-region/all-event delivery or retention proof. Reuses prior core region-trail contracts, account-wide branch source-inspected but not independently SDK exercised here.

account_metric_alarm.producer: aws_account_configuration scope subject plus cloudtrail_account_inventory and metric_alarm_account_inventory.
account_metric_alarm.consumer: aws_gap_metrics.coverage -> management_coverage -> bounded JSON pattern parser/probes -> metric namespace/name/dimensions alarm join -> optional confirmed SNS subscription.
account_metric_alarm.field_contract: All dependency collection statuses; same-account/region/group ARN binding; trail selectors and logging; MetricFilters/Alarms/Subscriptions status wrappers and match fields.
account_metric_alarm.limits: Thirty IDs have callback/helper source review, not thirty new SDK proofs. Finite pattern probes do not prove all event-language semantics; alarm threshold/comparison/action delivery health are not evaluated. Unsupported pattern/partial dependencies remain UNKNOWN.

all_customer_policy_scope.producer: aws_customer_policies.collect ListPolicies Scope=Local OnlyAttached=False -> exact GetPolicyVersion(default) join.
all_customer_policy_scope.consumer: aws_all_policies.scan; six native IDs and two FedRAMP aliases use complete iam_customer_policy dependency, not selected GAAD item universe.
all_customer_policy_scope.field_contract: DefaultDocument.{collection_status,VersionId,Document}, DefaultVersionId exact equality, own-account unique policy ARN, provenance ListPolicies/Local/OnlyAttached=False.
all_customer_policy_scope.limits: Despite historical all-managed labels, corrected native scope is customer-managed attached+unattached only. No AWS-managed-wide assertion. NotAction/NotResource conservatively unresolved except known bounded positives; source-inspected existing contract, no new SDK probe here.

pci_native_join.producer: GAAD policies + own-account complete user/group/role inventories and native provenance; URL-decoded default documents.
pci_native_join.field_contract: Unique exact scoped selected policy, default-version identity, every principal ARN/name, managed attachment lists, attachment count, user GroupList and role trust documents.
pci_native_join.limits: Attachment criterion is declared usable membership/trust metadata, not observed activity; MFA predicate checks explicit condition syntax rather than complete authorization. Legacy synthetic attachment branch is not a producer claim. Source-inspected; existing focused PCI tests supply separate regression evidence.

service_access_unavailable.producer: _services_last_accessed -> _sla_reports deliberately generation_disabled; no GenerateServiceLastAccessedDetails permitted. Role namespace exclusion can attest no Bedrock identity allow.
service_access_unavailable.field_contract: ServicesLastAccessed[].ServiceNamespace/LastAuthenticated needed; ServicesLastAccessedStatus records not_collected reason, not fictitious empty list.
service_access_unavailable.limits: Without a preexisting complete report collector path these are UNKNOWN, except valid role namespace exclusion is NOT_APPLICABLE. Useful automatic metadata signal remains unsupported under current no-generation profile.

account_iam_scope.producer: global complete IAM role/user/group inventories derived from GAAD, current caller identity and partition context.
account_iam_scope.consumer: support/SecurityAudit named role+policy presence, exact CloudShell attachment scope, or exact CloudWatch-CrossAccountSharingRole name.
account_iam_scope.field_contract: Complete same-account global wrappers; role names/AttachedManagedPolicies, principal attachment lists; exact partition managed-policy ARN.
account_iam_scope.limits: Name/policy presence is bounded configuration evidence, not effective permissions, support plan, actual active use or delegated-account correctness; not independently SDK-tested in this report.

defects.counterexample: GAAD default Document={} or missing/invalid Effect/selector returned PASS (two AgentCore engines returned MANUAL); SDK accepts Document as opaque JSON string.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: document_of now validates Statement list/object, exact Allow/Deny, exclusive nonempty string selectors and Condition dictionary before pattern engines. Empty Statement list remains empty; identity-only Resource validation does not apply to service trust.

defects.counterexample: CSV both active=MALFORMED with dates=N/A returned PASS. Active=true with rotated=N/A previously shortcut to no keys.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Validate both active slots through flag before early exits; active key date omission UNKNOWN. Four callbacks fixed; no-key false/false stays PASS.

defects.counterexample: Contradictory imported GAAD row DefaultVersionId=v2 but sole IsDefaultVersion=true VersionId=v1 with narrow document returns PASS.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Authorized shared default_document now requires nonempty DefaultVersionId, nonempty unique VersionIds and exactly one boolean default whose VersionId matches. SDK mutation receipts cover missing IDs, duplicate IDs/defaults and mismatches. SQL/Prowler consumers of this helper inherit validation; separate helpers are recorded below.

defects.counterexample: Member mfa_active=MALFORMED returns PASS; duplicate same-user credential rows false then true overwrite first and return PASS.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Reject empty/duplicate credential usernames and use strict flag for selected group member MFA. Actual SDK GAAD GroupList + CSV join PASS/FAIL/malformed/duplicate/missing-member receipts now pass. General credential ARN/name schema/freshness validation remains a separate limit.

defects.counterexample: Unrecognized non-ARN SerialNumber string is classified hardware by Prowler split fallback; root subtracts virtual devices from summary rather than proving device assurance.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Keep explicit device-type heuristic scope; validate malformed/empty serial strings separately and avoid assurance/certification claim.

defects.counterexample: Parser retains ReportGeneratedTime but does not enforce freshness/schema/identity uniqueness globally; native credentials do not enumerate federated sessions.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Consumer-specific strictness remains documented; no live report generation or federated evidence was inferred.

defects.counterexample: Actual GAAD SDK stub -> _iam -> make_snapshot -> evaluate_snapshot returns PASS when scope is own-account/global but either envelope.account_id or item.AccountId is foreign. Narrow observed document is valid; account attribution is contradictory.
defects.source: peaso/engine.py::evaluate_snapshot.scoped_index.relevant returns True for exact scope before global-account identity validation; resource selection proceeds separately.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Root-owned engine scope/import validation should reject contradictory AWS global subject/envelope identity. Preserve valid observed resource PASS with a separate UNKNOWN incomplete-inventory notice. Same-scope trust affects broader subject/dependency paths, but only named IAM ID is directly proven.

defects.counterexample: SDK GAAD policy with DefaultVersionId=v2, sole flagged IsDefaultVersion=true VersionId=v1 narrow document still returns PASS through these separate helpers.
defects.resolution_or_proposal: Require the same exact default version identity binding before negative policy conclusions. Root notified; no unauthorized shared/core file edits. Noncore aws_policy_constraints_review_20261019._managed_document also has flag-only source pattern, but belongs to another review owner and is not counted as directly executed here.
